_docs.master_host_runtime: Agent CLI name the master session runs on (for example claude, codex, or grok).
_docs.transcript_globs: Map of runtime name to a filesystem glob that locates that runtime's session JSONL transcripts for model-identity probes.
_docs.product_repositories: Non-empty array of absolute paths of the product repositories this master serves; the canonical key. The one-entry string form product_repo is still accepted; when both are present, product_repositories wins. Omit both when the workspace has no product repository.
_docs.unavailable_runtimes: Optional map of runtime name to {since, why}, both non-empty strings; operator-declared runtimes this machine or account cannot dispatch to. Absent key means no change.
